description: Language-neutral runtime contract v1 samples shared by the Python and TypeScript gates. Every wire value is a real projection: the Python gate re-derives it from the production projection code and checks it against the declared manifest schema, the TypeScript gate checks the same file against the generated contract module.

events.name: info_string_payload
events.notes: The info producer sends a bare JSON string; v1 introduces no InfoPayload wrapper.

events.name: answer_delta_text_payload
events.notes: Known kind with a structured payload; every declared field is present.

events.name: future_unknown_kind_and_fields
events.notes: A kind a newer server may add within the frozen v1 envelope (same-version additive): the envelope keeps the six v1 keys and the real v1 version, and the payload carries fields no v1 client knows, so a client must fall back to JsonValue without dropping the unknown fields.

session_read.notes: Real projection of a session snapshot: no runtime handle, no goal object, and no wall-clock field is carried.
